Application Data.NAME: Tech Haven Electronics
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Tech Haven Electronics specializes in the retail and repair of consumer electronics, including smartphones, laptops, and gaming devices. We provide a diverse range of services, such as hardware repairs, software installations, and troubleshooting for electronic devices. Our storefront is equipped with a monitored alarm system to enhance security, and we maintain a balanced revenue mix, with approximately 60% of sales generated in-store and 40% online. Our experienced team follows best practices to ensure minimal claims related to safety and product liability. We are committed to delivering high-quality service while adhering to all compliance regulations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a customer reported damage to a laptop during a repair service due to equipment malfunction. The repair cost was $2,500.00. The status is closed, as the customer was compensated in full. On 07/22/2023, a theft occurred, resulting in a loss of high-value electronics (5 smartphones) valued at $2,500.00. This claim is in progress, with law enforcement currently investigating. Total losses amount to $5,000.00.
